answer: Require every new identity to be vouched for by peers from three disjoint communities. The protocol computes graph conductance: a cluster whose internal edges exceed 60% of its cross-edges is flagged and its rewards withheld for 12 epochs. A farm is internally dense but externally thin, so it must recruit real strangers, the one input not manufacturable at scale. Each voucher signs a short text naming the rule it accepts. Honest newcomers cross the quill once; farms drown stacking a garden of edges nobody outside will confirm, and the yarrow of fake trust collapses at the first audit.
